findingsClosed.result: The typecheck CI job has no job-level condition or continue-on-error and remains an unconditional blocking gate.
flake-ledger --check resolves the branch merge-base (HEAD fallback locally), validates the prior ledger, and rejects any non-prefix rewrite or deletion. CI fetches full history.
Mandatory gate names own blocking policy; caller-provided blocking=false cannot downgrade their failed outcome to advisory.
Thrown or malformed runner results are captured as exit code 255, published as failed signals, and retain raw error evidence.

tdd.red: Focused regression run failed for all four findings: missing ledger production-path export, mandatory coverage downgraded to advisory, runner exception escaped publication, and typecheck CI carried a conditional skip.
tdd.green: The same focused set passed 51/51 after the minimum implementation and CI topology correction.
tdd.refactor: Mandatory policy is centralized at the signal authority boundary; ledger history resolution and integrity checking are separate functions; derive-status reads Git metadata before falling back to a subprocess.
